author: Prathkum
text:
NVIDIA bought the front door of the entire open-source AI ecosystem for $12.93B.

The scale HF operates at:

– 18M+ developers, researchers, and creators
– 3M+ models
– 500K+ datasets
– 1M+ applications
– 200K+ companies using the platform

A few thoughts on why NVIDIA did this:

• Owning the compute layer isn't enough anymore, distribution and discovery are becoming just as strategic

• NVIDIA is already the largest contributor of open models/data to HF, 500+ models and 250+ datasets released there

• Buying HF locks in relevance at the exact layer where developers decide what to build with, before they even touch hardware

• This echoes Microsoft buying GitHub in 2018, same playbook of acquiring the community hub instead of building one.
